stem.text: An observer is standing on a railway platform. A train passes the observer at constant speed while emitting sound of constant frequency $f$ from its whistle.

A.text: sound of a decreasing frequency as the train approaches and of an increasing frequency as it moves away

B.text: sound of a higher frequency than $f$ as the train approaches and of a lower frequency than $f$ as the train moves away

C.text: sound of a lower frequency than $f$ as the train approaches and of a higher frequency than $f$ as the train moves away

D.text: sound of an increasing frequency as the train approaches and as it moves away
